prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, when a vehicle in the lane I was moving into drifted over and sideswiped the passenger side of my car. I pulled onto the shoulder right away and stayed at the scene until the police report was filed. My story has not changed since that moment: I have described the same sequence of events to the officer, to the adjuster, and to my own doctor. The impact pushed my car toward the median, and as I braced against the steering wheel and door frame, I felt my left wrist strike the console. I was seen at a clinic the same day, where an X-ray confirmed a fractured wrist and I was placed in a splint. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed.
